deploy-bot: Deploy started: tag `v1.4.7-hotpatch-cherry` -> production. Environment: prod. Canary region: us-west-2 (5% traffic). Commit: `c3f9a8b`. Reason: cherry-pick fix for tokenization crash on long prompts. ---
tina (release-engineer): FYI I'm watching canary metrics + logs. Will promote to 100% if stable for 10m. :eyes:
jamal (oncall-sre): Noted. I'll tail app errors and latency dashboards. Ping me if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency +100ms.
olga (backend): quick note: this change touched tokenizer code and embedding pipeline. Rolling back could be entangled with batching config. If we need rollback, prefer route-level pin rather than full rollback.
maria (qa): Running smoke tests now against canary URL. Will paste failures here.
infra-bot: Canary instances created: i-0a1b2c3d (3 pods behind), LB config applied.
maria (qa): Smoke: POST /v1/embeddings with long prompt -> 502 x2, otherwise OK. Logs show tokenizer exception: `IndexError: tokenizer overflow` at `tokenize.py:74`.
jamal (oncall-sre): seeing spike, 5xx at 0.8% last 2m. Rolling window breach.
tina (release-engineer): Hmm. Two failures consistent with maria. Olga, can you confirm if commit includes bounds check?
olga (backend): I pushed fix but cherry-pick might have missed an edge check. I can hotfix quickly but prefer to pin route for now. Suggest: partial rollback of embedding route to `v1.4.6` while we patch. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/emb-service emb=redwood/emb:v1.4.6 --namespace=prod`
jamal (oncall-sre): Partial rollback sounds good. Reduces blast radius. Tina, approve?
tina (release-engineer): Approve. Execute partial rollback, monitor 2m. Notify if any other regressions.
infra-bot: Starting rollout: updating deployment `emb-service` -> image `redwood/emb:v1.4.6`. Canary traffic for that route switched back to previous variant.
jamal (oncall-sre): 5xx dropped to 0.06% after rollback. p95 latency stable.
maria (qa): Smoke tests pass on embedding route now. No tokenization exceptions.
olga (backend): I'll branch `hotfix/v1.4.7-tokenizer-edge` and push fix. Will request quick review.
tina (release-engineer): After olga's patch lands, we'll re-run an isolated canary for the embedding service and then promote. Keeping tag `v1.47-hotpatch-cherry` as a marker; final promote will use `v1.4.7` (post-patch).
deploy-bot: Canary for `v1.4.7-hotpatch-cherry` partially rolled back for route `embeddings`. Deploy status: PARTIAL_ROLLBACK. Affected: embeddings route. Other routes remain on `v1.4.7-hotpatch-cherry` (canary).
jamal (oncall-sre): Good containment. Logging incident note: short-lived partial rollback, root cause: tokenizer bounds missing in cherry-pick. No customer-facing degradation observed beyond brief errors.
tina (release-engineer): I'll open a release note snippet: "Partial rollback of embeddings to v1.4.6 due to tokenizer edge-case in v1.4.7 cherry-pick. Patch incoming; will re-deploy when validated." Adding to changelog and postmortem placeholder.
olga (backend): Patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/emb/pulls/312. Includes unit + integration tests for long prompt tokenization.
maria (qa): Ready to run canary once PR merged. Leave emb route at v1.4.6 until then.
tina (release-engineer): Thanks all. Closing thread when promote completes. For now status: PARTIAL_ROLLBACK -> stable. :white_check_mark:
